title: App is great! Very useful for tracking and journaling
body: I think this app is lovely! It's very useful to track all sorts of habit. More importantly I love that there is a journaling feature embedded within it. A major improvement I hope you can consider is graph tracking. For example with sleeping early, I can keep count of how often I sleep early. But I'd love to see at what time I sleep everyday throughout the month and see it on a graph. Maybe you can add time as an input for a habit when that's completed or something. And it can be visualized as a time graph? Otherwise this is awesome
author: TSIXOHVPVP

title: Finally one App that does it well
body: I really enjoy using the Hello Habit app! The simplicity and comprehensive options it offers make it easy to set and track my goals. The integration with Apple Health is a fantastic feature for keeping an eye on my health progress. Plus, the visuals are incredibly engaging, which makes staying motivated a breeze! Highly recommend!
author: Stefano-Nta
